subject: Encryption & residency: follow-up from demo + qualification
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@clearfinancial.com>, Tom Bergeron <tom.bergeron@clearfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Encryption & residency: follow-up from demo + qualification

Hi Anna / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today — appreciate the practical questions from your security and infra teams. Quick recap from our side and a short list of asks so we can size the Private deployment and the customer-managed key (CMK) path correctly.

High-level recap
- You run EU-only workloads; data residency in the Frankfurt region is a hard requirement.
- You need PII redaction options for user-submitted text and token-level audit logs retained for 1 year.
- Desired encryption posture: TLS in-transit + at-rest AES-256; preference for customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed key storage.

Asks / next steps (what we need from Clear Financial)
1) Confirm whether Clear Financial will provide a KMS/HSM in your VPC (bring-your-own-key) or if you prefer Redwood to manage keys in an EU KMS with a strict access policy.
2) Which specific HSM solution is in scope (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM, or on-prem Thales/HSM appliance)? If you have a vendor + model, share the contact.
3) Can you provide a short answers file to the attached questionnaire (sheet Tab: "Encryption & Logging") — this helps our engineering scoping.
4) Any non-standard retention exceptions (some of your datasets may need 0-day retention).

What Redwood can commit to now
- Private (VPC) deployment in eu-central-1 with KMS integration patterns commonly used for FinServ.
- Token-level logging with configurable retention; we can deploy 1-year retention out of the box for the pilot.
- Support for external HSM-wrapped CMKs where the CMK never leaves your control; we will provide the integration runbook and sample Terraform.

I'll loop in Soojin to capture operational questions and Marissa on the commercial path. If possible, can you send the completed questionnaire by EOD Wed (17 Mar)? That will let us provide an estimated SOW and pilot cost.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0188
[Attachment: redwood-kms-options-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@clearfinancial.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bergeron <tom.bergeron@clearfinancial.com>, security@clearfinancial.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Encryption & residency: follow-up from demo + qualification

Thanks Rishi — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our security team below.

On BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys
- Our preference is BYOK. We operate an on-prem Thales Luna appliance for high-value keys and would like the option to keep CMKs under our HSM control.

On logging and retention
- 1 year retention for token-level logs is acceptable for the pilot. We will need an export path (S3) for archived logs for our audit pipeline.

On network & deployment
- EU-only: eu-central-1 (Frankfurt).
- Can you confirm whether the Private control plane will require any egress to Redwood-managed endpoints outside EU for updates/metrics? Our compliance team will flag any need to route telemetry via our egress proxies.

We'll fill the questionnaire — attaching a preliminary answers sheet (see attached). We'll try to get it back to you by Wed.

Anna Kovacs
Head of Security Engineering | Clear Financial
anna.kovacs@clearfinancial.com
[Attachment: clearbank-encryption-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:08:43 -0400
Subject: Re: Encryption & residency: follow-up from demo + qualification

Looping in Soojin (PM, Private) and Priyom (Security/Integrations) to take the technical scoping. Initial notes:
- BYOK + Thales support: engineering will need the HSM vendor details and a certificate for mutual TLS if we are doing HSM client auth. Ask Anna for the appliance model and whether they prefer PKCS#11 or KMIP.
- Egress: we can offer an "EU-only" control-plane mode where telemetry endpoints are in EU; need product approvals, could add to SOW as an option.
- Logs: we support S3 exports; for the pilot we should propose daily export + lifecycle rule to Glacier after 90 days unless they request otherwise.

Priyom — can you draft a short migration/integration checklist we can share with Anna? Include required inbound ports, certs, and the Terraform snippet for CMK registration.

Marissa

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@clearfinancial.com>, Tom Bergeron <tom.bergeron@clearfinancial.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Encryption & residency: follow-up from demo + qualification

Hi Anna / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the partial questionnaire. A few concrete items from our side so you can hand these to your infra team:

1) HSM integration modes we support- PKCS#11 (most Thales):- Redwood can call a customer-hosted PKCS#11 endpoint over a VPC peered connection; key material never moves to Redwood.
- KMIP (Thales/Entrust appliances supported) via TLS mutual auth.
- Cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) — Redwood trusts the cloud KMS for wrapping/unwrapping.

2) Needed artifacts from Clear Financial- HSM vendor + model and preferred API (PKCS#11 vs KMIP)- A service account cert for mTLS (if KMIP) or the PKCS#11 endpoint and credential process- S3 bucket ARN & IAM principal if you want daily export of token logs

3) Control-plane egress- Short answer: we can operate in a locked-down EU control plane for the pilot. We will need to exchange a small list of outbound FQDN/IPs that your proxies can allow (we will provide this list; we do not phone-home arbitrary telemetry).

4) Pilot deliverables & timeline- SOW draft: integration runbook, CMK registration, daily token log export to S3, 1-year retention configured, pilot for 4 weeks.
- Target: SOW and pricing estimate by Fri 19 Mar once we have the completed questionnaire and HSM details.

Next step: Rishi — can you coordinate and confirm whether Anna can share the HSM model + completed questionnaire by EOD Wed? We'll take it from there and produce the SOW.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
[Attachment: integration-checklist.txt (txt)]
